question: Levamisole is used as all except -
analysis: Levamisole is an anthelmintic and immunomodulatory drug. It is used as a single dose treatment for ascariasis (option a) and acts by causing paralysis of worms through depolarization (option c). It is also known to have immunostimulant properties (option b). However, it is not used as an immunodepressant in high doses, making option d incorrect.
